title: Virtual transition states: making sense of multiple transition states in parallel and series
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9145-9160
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00868E, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ian H. Williams
Experiments on reactions with multiple kinetically significant transition states (TSs), in series or parallel, yield information about virtual TSs, which are weighted averages of one or more real TSs.
